title: What's new in Expense Agent: Use Travel Request
summary: This video shows the optional travel request feature (also called spend request) in the Expense Agent, demoed in the Business Central client. An employee asks for permission to spend, the manager approves, and the employee later creates an expense report that points to the travel request. The demo covers itemized request lines with foreign currency amounts, the approval info, and the link from posted general ledger entries back to the request for audit. It also explains how to budget in a foreign currency by updating the local currency amount. The speaker notes that the web app and phone app versions are not ready yet, and that the Expense Agent creates the expense report automatically.

features.name: Travel requests (spend requests)
features.description: An optional feature that lets employees ask for permission to spend money, gives the company an overview of expected expenses, and documents who authorized a spend. The process is request, manager approval, spending, expense report, approval and posting.
caveats: Demo is in the Business Central client only

features.name: Travel request lines with local and foreign currency
features.description: Requests can be itemized into lines so the manager sees what expenses to expect. Amounts in foreign currency such as euro are translated into the local currency, and a schedule and from/to locations can be added.

features.name: Travel request approval information
features.description: The request shows who approved it and when. The demoed request is approved with an expected spend of approximately 4,000.

features.name: Travel request reference on the expense report
features.description: When the employee is back, the expense report specifies the travel request it belongs to. In the demo, the report refers to travel request number two and shows actuals such as a slightly more expensive airline ticket and hotel.

features.name: Audit link between GL entries and travel request
features.description: After posting, the posted expense report shows expense ledger entries, an employee ledger entry for the reimbursement, and a link from the GL entries to the travel request. This lets an auditor see who authorized a given spend.

features.name: Budgeting in foreign currency with local amount update
features.description: For countries with volatile currency or high inflation, a request can be budgeted in a foreign currency such as Swiss francs. An action updates the local currency amount to match the foreign amount when the travel happens.
caveats: Explained with an example, not shown step by step

features.name: List of travelers on a travel request
features.description: Besides the requesting employee, a list of travelers can be included on the travel request if other people are going.

features.name: Automatic expense report creation from a travel request in the Expense Agent
features.description: When the travel request is made in the Expense Agent, the expense report is created automatically. Only in Business Central does the user need to create it manually.
caveats: Manual creation is only needed in Business Central

features.name: Travel requests in Expense Agent web app and phone app
features.description: The same travel request functionality will be available in the Expense Agent web app and phone app, but these were not ready at recording time.
